text:
elaine: Quick sync: we need a crisp plan for the long-term platform topology delegation story — routing policies, multi-region behavior, and tenant isolation. customers keep asking for predictable cutovers and SLA guarantees.

elaine: Goal: define launch criteria + handoff checklist for product + eng + SRE. I sketched a matrix. posting asks and constraints here.

david: +1. we should separate policy (who decides routing) from topology (where it runs). delegation lets product set intent without ops changes.

priya: From product side: customers require: 99.9% regional availability, documented fallback behavior, and a tested cutover playbook. we should include canary + traffic quotas as must-haves.

kai: Technical constraints: live KV cache semantics across regions are the hard part. cross-region KV invalidation will add tail latency if we aren't careful. preferring eventual consistency with explicit TTLs.

maria: FYI sales: several EEs asking for per-tenant affinity and legal-residency routing by EOY. they expect rollout plan and migration windows.

elaine: Proposed launch criteria (draft):
- policy DSL v1 stable (read-only in control-plane)
- canary routing + rollback in console
- documented per-tenant SLA expectations (latency/cost profile)
- playbook verified in staging with at least 2 real tenants
- metrics: per-route p50/p95, error-rate, and fallback invocations

priya: Can we add acceptance tests: synthetic traffic that simulates geo-failover and tenant relocation? PASS/FAIL gating for rollouts.

kai: yes. testing matrix idea:
```
scenario,expected
single-region-failure,requests->fallback-region within 500ms
kv-stale,serve-stale-with-warning
tenant-cutover,zero-ops-downtime-or-rollback
```

ops-bot: note: runbook template created: /runbooks/topology-delegation-cutover.md (staging link) :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: automated smoke jobs: topology-smoke-v1 scheduled on staging every 2h.

david: architecture note: we need an explicit escape hatch: when delegated policy would violate capacity SLOs we auto-fallback to platform default route. that should be configurable per-tenant.

maria: customers will want pricing tiers for dedicated-affinity vs shared routing. include pricing ask in the handoff doc.

elaine: scope negotiation: must-have at launch vs follow-ups.
- must-have: policy DSL v1, canary routing, documented SLAs, playbook tests
- follow-up: policy authoring UI, per-tenant cost estimator, cross-region KV replication tuning

priya: timeline ask: PM wants a Q3 alpha with selected customers, Q4 general availability. do we agree?

kai: Q3 alpha is feasible if eng focuses on core runtime + canary plumbing. cross-region KV improvements can go to follow-up.

david: devops concerns: capacity gating for delegated policies needs quotas to prevent noisy neighbors. add quota enforcement to alpha.

elaine: action items:
- david: write a short design doc for the escape-hatch + quota model (owner: david) — due 1781012500
- kai: prototype canary plumbing + smoke harness in staging (owner: kai) — due 1781013000
- priya: synth-test matrix and acceptance criteria (owner: priya) — due 1781012600
- maria: collect customer priority list and pricing expectations (owner: maria) — due 1781012700
- ops-bot: wire runbook into staging and enable smoke jobs (owner: ops-bot) — done

priya: Can we also get a minimal policy example to show customers?

kai: example policy DSL (very small):
```
policy: {
  name: "tenant-geo-prefer",
  match: { tenant_id: "T-123" },
  intent: [ {region: "us-west", weight: 0.9}, {region: "us-east", weight: 0.1} ],
  fallback: { type: "platform-default" }
}
```

elaine: love it. last Q: any objections to the Q3 alpha target?

david: no objections. call out risk: KV tail latency could require more infra. put that in RISK register.

maria: sales aligned if we can promise an alpha window to 2 anchor customers.

elaine: OK — I'll assemble the launch checklist + negotiation doc and share a draft by EOD. thanks all. :tada:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled meeting created: topology-delegation-sync 1781012450 (calendar invite sent).
